themes.description: Users are finding that the cashback policy has been updated, limiting the use of accumulated cashback rewards to only US stocks, effectively rendering them unusable for bill payments or recharges.
themes.business_impact: Churn risk and negative word-of-mouth due to perceived unfairness of policy update, potential loss of revenue from affected users.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The policy update was implemented without proper communication to users, leading to a sense of betrayal and mistrust.
themes.action_plan:
• 1. Communicate the policy update clearly and transparently to all users, explaining the reasons behind the change. 
• 2. Introduce a new notification mechanism to alert users when their cashback rewards are about to expire or become unusable. 
• 3. Consider adding a 'use it or lose it' option for accumulated cashback rewards. 
• 4. Analyze user feedback and adjust the policy accordingly, prioritizing user needs and satisfaction.

themes.description: Users experienced frequent app crashes, freezes, and unresponsiveness, preventing them from using the app for trading.
themes.business_impact: High loss of potential trades, revenue, and customers due to app instability and lack of usability.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The app's instability and lack of usability are likely caused by poor coding practices, inadequate testing, and insufficient resources allocated to the development team.
themes.action_plan: • Investigate and fix the underlying causes of app crashes and freezes, implement robust testing strategies, allocate additional resources to the development team, and conduct thorough user acceptance testing.

themes.description: Users experience severe problems with stock trades, portfolio tracking, and analysis features. Issues include failed transactions, inaccurate or missing data, and usability problems with the interface.
themes.business_impact: Losses from failed trades, decreased user trust, and potential churn due to frustration with fundamental app features.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Insufficient testing and QA of critical trade and portfolio features, inadequate UX refinement, and outdated data analytics infrastructure.
themes.action_plan:
• Perform thorough UX design revamp with user feedback
• Enhance data analytics infrastructure
